issues.title: PS Muthoni says Kenya has no Ebola outbreak as surveillance intensifies
issues.title_en: PS Muthoni says Kenya has no Ebola outbreak as surveillance intensifies
issues.summary: Principal Secretary for Health and Professional Standards Mary Muthoni has assured Kenyans that the country has not experienced an Ebola outbreak, saying health authorities have stepped up surveillance following confirmation of a single imported case.
